input.rationale: The agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant binding the Company (our client). Full-text searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "hire", "induce", "recruit", and "personnel" returned no restrictive personnel covenant; the only employee-related references are the confidentiality carve-out (p0051) and the no-joint-venture/independent-contractor clause (p0061), neither of which restricts hiring. Section 5.4, the only personnel-facing provision, simply requires each Party to appoint a General Manager as liaison. Section 6 (Exclusivity) imposes product/market non-competes rather than personnel restrictions and is outside this rule's scope. This matches our preferred position of no non-solicit on the Customer, so no redline is required.
